note: The held-out outcome set (construct-gsf). labeled-outcomes.json was written alongside the keyword catalog, so it shares vocabulary with it and scored a 0.000 miss rate that did not survive contact with wording it had not authored: the construct-r67.9 dogfood scored 0.556 on the same measure. A corpus and a catalog authored by the same mind cannot measure each other.
discipline: Every outcome here is written the way a person describes a situation, not the way the catalog names a domain. The rule while writing: state the situation first, then say it in the plainest words available, and do not reach for a term because the catalog contains it. Jargon appears only where a real person would actually use it. `expect` is what a competent human would say the outcome genuinely implicates, decided from the situation and not from what the matcher happens to find.
howToExtend: Add outcomes by describing a situation and writing it plainly — never by reading the keyword lists and paraphrasing them, and never by taking a failing case and rewording it until it passes. If a fix requires adding a word to the catalog, that word belongs there because a user would say it, not because this file does.
